description: This file defines the LeaveTypeService class for the OrangeHRM leave management module, providing methods to interact with leave types such as retrieving eligible leave types for an employee, and converting leave type objects into array representations.

classes.name: LeaveTypeService
classes.description: A service class providing operations related to leave types, including retrieval based on employee eligibility and conversion to array format.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeDao
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of LeaveTypeDao, initializing it if it hasn't been instantiated yet.

methods.name: getEligibleLeaveTypesByEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns a list of leave types for which an employee with a given employee number is eligible, optionally including leave types with allocated leaves.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeAsArray
methods.description: Fetches a leave type by its ID and returns its normalized array representation, appending a 'deleted' label if applicable.
